analysis:
Compared the supplied BASE/HEAD source, patch and file metadata. Start/StartCommand+Modes.swift:413 changes only quarantine wording; local authentication, bind-confirmed discovery, model selection, startup update execution, scheduled serving, termination and fan leases are unchanged. UpdateCommand.swift:44-57 adds explicit rollback/confirmation flags and rejects incompatible check-only, quarantine-override and coordinator options. Lines 69-75 dispatch rollback with configured drain options; normal update/restart behavior at 174-196 is unchanged. These visible changes do not independently establish an authorization, encryption, data-exposure or billing regression.
The added UpdateRollback.swift is supplied as metadata with only a bounded orientation excerpt, not its full implementation. Its visible declarations describe predecessor restoration, quarantine, cluster refusal, drain-held update lease and restart authorization, but comments are not proof of those controls. Integration must examine the complete rollback implementation and SelfUpdater.rollBackToPredecessor for artifact integrity/identity and journal handling (T-013, T-034, T-043, T-054), confirmation and cluster checks, concurrency with stop/update, quarantine persistence and failure recovery (A-018), and draining/restarting without carrying stale serving authorization (T-053). Validate bounded fan activity across replacement (T-047) and compatibility of retained encrypted cache artifacts if predecessor layouts differ (T-041); no incompatible predecessor is established here. The missing implementation is a material coverage limit, not evidence of a missing control or of safety.
